_comment: cargo-geiger baseline (T1174): total unsafe items/expressions summed over workspace crates (used + unused). CI fails when the total grows; lower it when unsafe is removed. NOTE: cargo-geiger folds dependency unsafe into the binary package's entry, so the tool's total is clj-rt 110 + clj-aot 11 + clojure-rs rollup 121 = 242 (R1 finding 2); own-counts are unchanged. T1192 D-argv adds the clj-rt +21 (rt_argv shim + its FFI-boundary tests; the rollup folds the same +21). T73 item 8 adds +24 (rt_keyword shim + its FFI-boundary tests: clj-rt +12, rollup +12).
